purpose: Teach: コマース/押し出し/平米/弐/作製/一任/隔週/通りかかっ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、Eコマースの強化策を検討しろ
lines.en: I want you to work up a strengthening strategy for our e-commerce division.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Direct eye contact. Measured pace with slight weight on the key word. No room for negotiation. The tone of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品で市場への押し出しを強くいたします
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll push the new product line hard into the market.
lines.style: Respectful nod embedded in the voice. Crisp, efficient delivery. Forward-leaning energy — eager to execute. Professional distance maintained, but present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本社の平米数を確認しろ
lines.en: And verify the square footage of our headquarters office.
lines.style: Same crisp authority as the first line. Slight pause before the task — establishing it as separate but equally important. No elaboration. Expects compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。価格を一弐の単位で再設定しました
lines.en: Yes, sir. We've recalibrated the pricing structure in two-unit increments.
lines.style: Steady, factual report. No flourish. Suggests work already underway or completed. Quiet competence — not seeking praise, just informing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新パンフレットの作製を急げ
lines.en: I need the new brochure designed and printed. Make it a priority.
lines.style: Sharper than the previous directives. Slight lean forward in the voice. Impatience barely held in check. The closing sentence carries a touch of edge.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。本件は専門家に一任いたしました
lines.en: Yes, sir. I've already handed that off to our design specialists.
lines.style: Quick, reassuring. Anticipating the urgency. Slight relief in the tone — the work is already in motion. Efficient without being rushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員向け研修を隔週で実施しろ
lines.en: Roll out staff training sessions. Every other week, starting immediately.
lines.style: Clipped, decisive. Each phrase lands like a checklist item. Finality on 'immediately.' No questions expected. The voice of someone managing scale.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。たまたま通りかかったお得意様に声をかけられました
lines.en: Yes, sir. Actually, I ran into one of our best clients in the hallway just now and touched base with them.
lines.style: Lighter tone shifts the air. A small smile in the voice — pleased coincidence. The pace softens slightly. Hints at something beyond the formal report — a small human moment within protocol.
